{{Top}}
A '''listening device''' or '''audio eavesdropper'''<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> was a piece of covert audio technology used to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on an enemy, wherever they were stationed, be it hideout, temporary lodging, or outpost.

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] sent a team to place a listening device in the [[Imperial Communications Center (Iyuta)|Imperial Communications Center]] in [[Iyuta]].
